713:t_150:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Now I will teach you about god-killing power that surpasses even love!!」

713:t_150:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「My... our loving hearts won't lose to that!!」

713:t_151:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Anyone with doubts has no place before me!」

713:t_151:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...That... isn't for you to decide...」

713:t_151:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... will fight... because right now... that's all I can do!」

713:t_151:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You will overcome your doubts through battle...」

713:t_151:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, boy! I recognize you as worthy of fighting me!」

713:t_151:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't need that... But... I...!」

713:t_152:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're pathetic! I've never seen anyone fight such a pointless battle!」

713:t_152:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You talk about your mission, but once you defeat the $$御使い$$s, your life will be nothing but an empty shell!」

713:t_152:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Basically, you're fighting to kill yourself!」

713:t_152:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so...! Even so, I cannot stop moving forward!」

713:t_152:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you can't stop, I'll stop you! And I'll teach you...」

713:t_152:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...how wonderful it is to fight for someone else!!」

713:t_153:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you want $$シンカ$$ too, you should stop fighting and seek a way to live together!」

713:t_153:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is a dream long past... Now I seek only power!」

713:t_153:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Power gained that way is meaningless! It makes you just like the $$御使い$$s!」

713:t_153:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I will advance! I can only keep running down a road from which I cannot turn back!」

713:t_153:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Then we will stop your battle!」

713:t_153:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I can't stand any more lives being sacrificed in meaningless battles!!」

713:t_154:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Forerunner! Have you gained even greater power through $$真化融合$$?!」

713:t_154:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll stop you with this power, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

713:t_154:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You... seem to be a being much like me.」

713:t_154:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't deny it. The way I am now, I could hardly call myself a forerunner of human evolution.」

713:t_154:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I've entrusted that mission to those who follow! I only want to see where humanity goes!」

713:t_154:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That is why I fight, to eliminate beings like you and the $$御使い$$s!」

713:t_154:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A clash between men with the same mission! But I will be the victor!!」

713:t_155:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you mourn the souls that were lost, stop this battle!」

713:t_155:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That would make their deaths meaningless.」

713:t_155:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is why I fight... to repay every life I took!」

713:t_155:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will not waste your souls either! They will become my flesh, blood, and fighting aura, and power to slay the $$御使い$$s!」

713:t_155:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't revel in your own deeds! You knew you could create power without such sacrifices! Why didn't you?!」

713:t_155:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I reject your battle! What the universe seeks... the truth... cannot be anything like that!!」

713:t_156:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Taking lives kills possibilities! Everything you've done has destroyed futures that might have happened!」

713:t_156:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「To repay them, I will slay the $$御使い$$s with this power!」

713:t_156:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even if you win, the lives that were lost won't return!」

713:t_156:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You should have gathered the power to fight and broadened its possibilities!」

713:t_156:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...It is all in the past...! If I cannot change the past, I can only fight to atone for it!」

713:t_156:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I fight to protect possibility... and the future! However hard that path is, I won't accept sacrificing lives to reach a goal!!」

713:t_157:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Taking lives to forge a future... You are just like we used to be!」

713:t_157:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Are you saying you have escaped that?」

713:t_157:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Past sins never disappear... But I learned that we can change.」

713:t_157:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「That is why I fight! I will offer this life... everything I have for peace!」

713:t_157:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A will that has overcome doubt... Your heart is stronger than mine...」

713:t_157:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I cannot allow myself to lose! With power gained by the methods you abandoned, I will surpass you!!」

713:t_158:0.en:
$$シン$$
「No matter how you dress it up, the lives you've taken will never return!」

713:t_158:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But they became power to defeat them.」

713:t_158:2.en:
$$シン$$
「We'll beat the $$御使い$$s without doing that!」

713:t_158:3.en:
$$シン$$
「To do that, I'll defeat you... you, bound to battle... here!」

713:t_158:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, warrior! I recognize that you have reached that state by overcoming sorrow and doubt!」

713:t_158:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I will surpass even that! That is god-killing power!!」

713:t_159:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Your intensity is impressive. You came here with resolve.」

713:t_159:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll look for what I can do before sacrificing someone... I'll stake my own life on that...!」

713:t_159:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「That is the resolve I've reached!」

713:t_159:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You overcame doubt and reached that point too...」

713:t_159:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Though our answers differ, we are beings of the same nature! Then there is no need to hold back!」

713:t_159:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I have to do this! I'll stop you with the wishes and power entrusted to me!」

713:t_160:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The man called the $$赤い彗星$$... You are a being of the same nature as me.」

713:t_160:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「I will not deny it. Like you, I was a man who would not hesitate to sacrifice others for his goal.」

713:t_160:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now I am just one man! I will take on the role of freeing you from the mission and responsibility that bind you!」

713:t_160:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If you can, then try! If you would stop me, show me power greater than mine!!」

713:t_161:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I confirm the target. The attack target is $$次元将$$ $$ヴィルダーク$$.」

713:t_161:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is good! Cast aside all doubt and challenge me!」

713:t_161:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Overcoming that gives me strength. That is how I have fought.」

713:t_161:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then show me that power, if you say you are the same as me!」

713:t_161:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I... will not become like you!」

713:t_162:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「You fight only for your mission, with nothing to protect! You're pathetic!」

713:t_162:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Do not think those words will intimidate me!」

713:t_162:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're just like $$ガイオウ$$ in that words won't reach you! Then there's only one thing to do!」

713:t_162:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I fight for what I must protect! I'll defeat you and return to her!!」

713:t_162:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, man who fights for love!」

713:t_162:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even with nothing to protect, I will fight to prove that I live!!」

713:t_163:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You! Don't hide behind logic and lie to your own heart!」

713:t_163:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Listen to my sooooong! And set your heart free!!」
